entries.clue: Chewy oat slab bound with butter and golden syrup, cut into squares.
Small handled vessel of milk set down beside the cups.
Pouched mother of the Wood, who carries a small joey in her pocket
Grey donkey of the Wood who mislays his tail and expects the worst
Warm hello, or the printed sentiment on the front of a card
Prickly yellow-blossomed bush named in chapter one as breaking a bear's fall
Striped stranger who wakes the bear at night to announce who he is
Visitor who arrives bearing a ribboned box and a healthy appetite
Sugary handfuls tipped into little bags to take home
Mid-morning pause for a cup and a biscuit, named after the hour it falls.
Bean milk alternative that can curdle in a hot acidic cup.
High backless perch at the window shelf, for a quick solitary cup.
